review: Read all five first-party modules and three test suites. The room pilot adds a validated local room-navigation link and mounts a read-only player-sharing queue only for the opened room with observed owner presence. Existing room create/open/close and owner heartbeat operations remain explicit and separate from voice/AI.

Saved Discord configuration requires the current website profile/session, excludes native-cookie borrowing, parses a strict bounded shared schema and rejects foreign owner or extra secret fields. Refresh/account invalidation clears old observations; request generation and abort cleanup suppress stale results. Management links are fixed by the shared contract; deployment flags are not installation, consent, permission or funding evidence.

Minecraft requests are read only after an explicit click. Only active Fabric bindings and opaque actor/release references are displayed; activation_available must be false. No approval or model/action endpoint is invoked by this queue. Availability errors stay distinct from an empty request list.

Authenticator UI uses same-origin uncached endpoints, in-memory provisioning/recovery state, explicit six-digit confirmation and saved-code acknowledgment. Private endpoints gate visibility. QR rendering uses the existing qrcode.react dependency; no vendor source is copied. Code expiry, provider origin, profile binding, replay rejection and actual factor enforcement remain backend responsibilities and separate acceptance work.

Normalized one test source label to Fixture world Fabric sensor. Other fixtures use explicit synthetic account, actor, intent and recovery-code values. No production changes during this review. Shared Discord schema/fixture and room-navigation helper were inspected as dependencies but are not exported by this web cohort.
limits: Private unfrozen source proposal only; no publication, account operation, invitation, room membership change, authenticator enrollment or code redemption performed.

Seventeen mocked tests cover Discord configuration, queue reads and basic enrollment/recovery UI. They do not prove installed ordinary-account acceptance, backend authentication, paid execution or live Minecraft/GPT Live handoff.

AccountRoomPilot invitation/queue integration is compiled and read but has no dedicated integration test in this cohort. Shared contracts resolve from canonical source; account portal and billing additions remain held.

Existing queue/TOTP state behavior across direct prop replacement, outstanding mutation/unmount navigation, provisioning expiry and room heartbeat/account switching require broader lifecycle/installed qualification. Source review is not security certification.
